prompts.water-melee:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular cutout animation rig sprite-parts atlas for Element Eater, a Korean 2D top-down dungeon action game.
Image 1 is a STYLE AND ENEMY IDENTITY reference: use the cute hostile little armored elemental golems shown in this dungeon, with rounded dark armored bodies, bold clean dark outlines, warm painterly highlights, glowing hostile eyes, short mechanical limbs. Do not reproduce the dungeon, hero, UI, health bars, scenery or text. This is a NEW enemy parts atlas, not a screenshot.
Output one portrait 4:5 canvas, exact grid FOUR columns and FIVE rows (20 square cells), completely transparent background. No lines, grid marks, labels, words or numbers.
Each column is one facing and applies consistently to every row: column 1 FRONT facing DOWN toward viewer, column 2 LEFT profile, column 3 RIGHT profile, column 4 REAR facing UP away from viewer. Rear must have NO eyes, face, or front mouth, but the same bright body color and elemental crest; do not darken it.
Row 1: ONLY the armored round head-torso core WITH its short elemental crest, NO arms, hands, legs or feet. Complete torso outline must be closed and unbroken, do not cut limb-shaped holes. Same round torso shell dimensions and center for all four facings; keep crest separate above the shell.
Row 2: ONLY the enemy's detached LEFT arm/forearm/hand assembly (one small piece per cell), matching the column facing.
Row 3: ONLY its detached RIGHT arm/forearm/hand assembly (one piece per cell), matching the column facing.
Row 4: ONLY its detached LEFT boot/foot (one piece per cell), matching the column facing.
Row 5: ONLY its detached RIGHT boot/foot (one piece per cell), matching the column facing.
Keep every part centered in its own cell with transparent margins. In row 1 the round armor shell itself should be 50% of cell width and 45% cell height, shell center at (50%,58%) of cell, crest top at 18% cell height. In rows 2/3 arms occupy at most 40% of cell width and height. In rows 4/5 boots occupy at most 32% width and 24% height. Never put a complete assembled character in a limb row. Single pose, no animation sequence here; these detached parts will be articulated by a script so the torso never scales or shifts.
Actual transparency with clean alpha; no baked shadow, floor, checkerboard, background, loose particles, sparks outside the crest, weapons, oversized wings, player character, smiling hero face or plant ears. Clean complete silhouette and generous gutters.
Archetype: CLOSE-RANGE CHASER / BRAWLER. Stocky round armored mini-golem, wide angular brow, TWO small narrow intensely glowing eyes in a dark metal mask, small squared gritted mouth, chunky matching armored forearms ending in big rounded gauntlet fists, short sturdy two boots. Front arm pieces look powerful and clearly larger than feet. No guns, no giant weapons. Body core sturdy and immovable.
Element: WATER. Deep cobalt-blue armor with cyan luminous seams and icy-cyan eye(s); small translucent turquoise water-fin crown above the round body (three short droplet-like fins, not flames). Gauntlets and boots cobalt blue with pale cyan accents. No red flames, no leaves or lightning.
